procedure.method: In this fresh independent session I read the exact packet, case, pinned rubric, review rules, method/addendum and adapter. I read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before any poster open and verified the 33 supplied input pins and PNG dimensions. The packet declares no source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so actual separate source opens and protected-layout reads are zero. I then sequentially called tools.view_image with detail original and emitted each exact pinned image at original detail: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same order. All fifteen successful poster displays were inspected before beginning the first copy-transcription stage, any mandatory judgment or any image/set score. Only after M5 thumbnail320 was displayed did I read and transcribe the native images already visible in the conversation, in twelve-entry packet order per member. No OCR, crops, replacement assets, image edits, peer reviews or maker records were used. There were no unresolved glyph ambiguities and no ambiguity revisits. All poster natives are 1672×941, usage views 720×405, and thumbnails 320×180; native ratio correctness uses the declared 0.5-pixel single-edge rounding allowance. These receipts attest actual viewing, not a helper exit or invented tool event/session ID.

evidence.observation: A person holds the chair back while another operates a screwdriver; large foreground hands stitch a fabric patch. These actions materially communicate shared chair and clothing repair.

content_form.location: two chair repairers and foreground sewing
content_form.observation: A shared chair task and a large clothing task put the practical objects named by the request at the center of the poster.

hierarchy.location: upper-left invitation, upper-right title, right schedule and lower-left application
hierarchy.observation: The reader has competing left and right starting points. Following the right title/promise into the date and fee then requires a return across the central figures to reach the deadline and URL; the workshop name is separated from its schedule on the opposite side. All copy is functional, but this route lacks a resolved professional hierarchy.

typography.observation: Hangul and Latin glyphs are clean and correctly spaced, punctuation is visible, and the title/invitation/date use clear size and weight differences.
The full body and small event/application lines remain readable; the URL stays intact and the long fee line is not clipped.

space.location: right fee line and side-column relationships
space.observation: The fee line extends to within roughly ten pixels of the right edge while adjacent schedule lines leave much more space. The text is divided into unequal side blocks and an isolated lower-left application pair, so margins and occupied-space relationships feel less settled than the central painting.
The long third explanatory line closely approaches the central figure while the lower left has a much larger open gap above registration, producing uneven text-to-image spacing.

image_material.location: painted chair, clothing and foreground hands
image_material.observation: Directional brush marks and warm wood against blue fabric are consistent across the figures and repair objects. The screwdriver and needle contacts are understandable within the painterly treatment.

emotion_control.location: smiling central repairers and bright sleeves
emotion_control.observation: The close, smiling participants and lively red/blue palette make repair feel social and inviting; the emotional effect remains tied to a concrete shared task.

ai_slop.observation: The prominent hands retain their repair roles, and the repeated brush texture is consistent with the image treatment. There is no visible pseudo-copy or arbitrary badge; the observed weaknesses are layout placement rather than an unexplained decorative system.

residuals: Hierarchy is 3: the title/schedule on the right, workshop/explanation on the left and application at lower left require repeated cross-canvas navigation.
Space is 3: the fee has a tight right margin of roughly ten pixels at usage720, and side-column spacing is uneven around the central figures.
The copy remains complete and readable; these are unresolved craft findings rather than a missing-copy or tiny-body violation.

hierarchy.observation: The red date begins the scan, time follows, and title/promise/body lead through the remaining participation details in one continuous column. The date has unusually high priority but the event identity and application remain clear.

space.location: tapered left text opening against the chair
space.observation: The irregular illustrated chair boundary shapes a generous column rather than a mechanical vertical split; left margins and paragraph gaps are controlled and the bottom URL is given clear space.

image_material.location: ink hatching on hands, wood and cloth
image_material.observation: A consistent duotone carved-print vocabulary distinguishes skin, chair grain and fabric, while the red patch and red date link image and information. The chair and sewing contacts remain understandable.

emotion_control.observation: The sturdy carved marks and cooperating hands communicate practical collective effort, while red accents create energy grounded in the repair patch and event date.

ai_slop.location: chair members, sewing needle and patch stitches
ai_slop.observation: The enlarged crop contains task-specific construction and a coherent print texture; the red thread belongs to the sewing action, and no arbitrary symbols or pseudo-labels interrupt the scene.

residuals: The red date is the first and strongest left-column entry, so event identity is encountered after scheduling; this is clear but less immediate than a title-first route.
The upper chair joining action relies on the separated rail and cooperating hands rather than a visible tightening tool; the large lower sewing action makes repair explicit.
At thumbnail320 the large date/title and print scene survive better than the lower registration text.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.observation: One continuous photographic tabletop carries a central title-to-registration column, with four people working on both sides. Its enclosing occupied scene and vertical reading route differ from all four alternatives.

Multicolor print vignettes surround a central large invitation and two-row information grid; a tool handoff at the top and thread around the edge connect separate tasks. This differs spatially and typographically from M5’s continuous left column and giant duotone crop, despite both using print-like marks.

Hard diagonal photo cuts juxtapose damaged and repaired objects; title and promise occupy opposite image corners and information uses a central pale polygon. It shares photographic wood/denim with M1 but changes viewpoint, image editing, spatial organization and reading route.

evidence.location: central figures and side text blocks
evidence.observation: A continuous central painted pair repairs a chair above a large foreground sewing action; invitation/body are left, title/schedule right, application lower left. This is a distinct two-sided reading system rather than the M1 center column or M3 montage, though its route has lower craft ratings.

evidence.location: date-first column and giant right crop
evidence.observation: A red serif date starts one continuous left column with serif-like narrative type; a navy/red print scene of hands, chair and fabric occupies most of the right. The crop, restrained color relationship, type roles and date-first route differ from M2’s multicolor perimeter/grid system and from the three photographic or painted compositions.

residuals: Diversity is strong at 4 through organization, image editing, type roles and reading routes; it is not inferred merely from media names.
M1 and M3 share photographic wood/blue fabric imagery, and M2 and M5 share a print vocabulary, so the set is less independent in visual language than an exceptional 5 would imply.
M4 retains hierarchy and space scores of 3; full-set diversity and count fidelity do not cancel those low image ratings.
This is one craft critic’s assessment of the pinned selected five-member packet. No other critic result or complete three-critic gate is assessed here.
